dataList.title: Explore B2F
dataList.description: We've reached B2F. Let's keep moving.

dataList.title: Head to the Skein Nest
dataList.description: We've made it down to B2F. Kromer's older sister mentioned a place called the Skein Nest. Let's head to the left.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the Skein Nest to the Left

dataList.title: Leave the Restroom
dataList.description: We tried to reach the Skein Nest, but a massive monster chased us down and killed us. It seemed to be after the Golden Cocoon we're carrying. For now, let's leave the Restroom and figure out another way through.

dataList.title: Head to the Skein Nest (2)
dataList.description: Looks like the monster has stepped away for the moment. Let's use this chance to make another run for the Skein Nest.

steps.goalDescription1: Head Back to the Skein Nest

dataList.title: Talk to B2F's Floor Manager
dataList.description: We made it safely to the Skein Nest. B2F's Floor Manager is here. Let's ask whether the Golden Cocoon can be spun into Golden Thread.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to the B2F's Floor Manager

dataList.title: Head to the Dyehouse
dataList.description: The Floor Manager says Golden Dye is needed to make Golden Thread. Someone named Palette in the Dyehouse should be able to help. We should leave through the corridor, then head upward to find the Dyehouse.

dataList.title: 소문 수집/미사용
dataList.description: Let's eavesdrop on the customers at work and gather information.

dataList.title: Find Naked and Negotiate
dataList.description: The wait for Golden Dye is absurdly long. Apparently, a Noir named Naked has the earliest place in line. Let's find Naked and see if we can negotiate for his place in the queue.

dataList.title: Ask Palette for L'Incolore Dye
dataList.description: Naked has no intention of giving up the Golden Dye for free. He'll trade it for a dye called L'Incolore instead. Let's return to Palette and ask if she can make some.

dataList.title: Burst the Tears at the Dye Storage
dataList.description: Luckily, Palette says she can make L'Incolore right away. In exchange, she wants us to burst Tears of different colors. They can apparently be found in the Dye Storage to the right. Collect 2 Yellow, 2 Red, and 2 Blue Dye, then bring them back to Palette.

dataList.title: Trade with Naked for Golden Dye
dataList.description: Palette gave us L'Incolore. I can't see any color in it at all, but... let's bring it to Naked and see if he'll trade us the Golden Dye.

steps.goalDescription1: Trade L'Incolore for Golden Dye with Naked

dataList.title: 황금염료/미사용
dataList.description: We should collect the Golden Dye from Palette.

steps.goalDescription1: Collect the Golden Dye from Palette

dataList.title: Return to the B2F Floor Manager
dataList.description: Thanks to Outis's eloquent requisition effort, Naked finally agreed to hand over the Golden Dye. Let's take it to the B2F Floor Manager.

steps.goalDescription1: Return to the B2F Floor Manager

dataList.title: Hold off the Intruders
dataList.description: While we were waiting for the Golden Cocoon to be spun into thread, we heard the sound of someone approaching from the corridor. They are probably after the Golden Skein. Hold the corridor entrance until the spinning is complete.

dataList.title: Collect the Completed Golden Skein
dataList.description: The unknown creature is down. Let's return to the B2F Floor Manager and collect the finished Golden Skein.

steps.goalDescription1: Collect the Finished Golden Skein from the B2F Floor Manager

dataList.title: Leave B2F
dataList.description: We have the finished Golden Skein. Looks like we're done here. Time to leave B2F.

dataList.title: Head to 3F
dataList.description: Time to head up to 3F and see if the Golden Skein can be woven into Golden Fabric.
